# Benefit Hunter

> Free tool and setup kit that helps founders find, qualify for, and apply to startup
> benefit programs — cloud credits, community licenses, and partner discounts — in the
> order that maximizes referral leverage. Runs entirely in the browser; no account
> required; optional Supabase sync.

A curated overview of the main entry points follows.

## App

- [Benefit Hunter app](https://benefits.navinhill.com/): interactive catalog of
  startup benefit programs with a matching profile, guided umbrella-first application
  order, real-dollars-by-stack totals, and per-program AI application drafts.

## Setup kit

- [Automation Kit](https://benefits.navinhill.com/automation-kit/): sanitized
  starter repo (zip) tracking your own startup credits and free tiers, with an
  optional self-serve Google Apps Script Gmail-to-Sheet registry-sync add-on.

## Source code

- [GitHub: jamesnavinhill/benefit-hunter](https://github.com/jamesnavinhill/benefit-hunter):
  public monorepo — Vite/React app under `apps/hunter/`, durable docs under `docs/`
  (catalog schema and data model in `docs/architecture/`, deployment in
  `docs/operations/`).

## Data freshness

Program values, eligibility, and URLs are sourced and dated in
`apps/hunter/scripts/` and `docs/reference/` of the repository. Programs change —
confirm terms on each vendor's official page before applying.
